entities.summary: Nigel Dick is an English music video director and filmmaker. Originally from Catterick, North Yorkshire, he is based in Los Angeles, California. He has directed music videos for artists such as Britney Spears, Toto, Band Aid and Guns N’ Roses and Oasis.
